# Nuit Works

> Nuit Works is a two-person web design and development studio based in the Maldives. We design, build, host and maintain websites for small businesses, and we take on international projects.

Website: https://www.nuit.works
Email: hello@nuit.works
Instagram: https://instagram.com/nuit.works
Location: Maldives (clients worldwide)

## What we offer

- Custom design: every website is designed from the ground up around your brand, your audience, and the way your customers use it. No templates.
- Development and launch: we build your site to be fast and fully responsive on every device, test it thoroughly, and take it live.
- Fast turnaround: a simple project can be live within a week of getting started.
- Hosting and support: a subscription. Once your site is live, we host and maintain it for a recurring fee, and make updates whenever your business needs them.
- Unlimited revisions: we refine the design until you are completely satisfied.

## Key facts

- Pricing is quote based and depends on the size of the project. Prices are fair and quoted clearly before work starts.
- Based in the Maldives; open to international projects.
- We work around the clock and reply to clients as quickly as we can.
- Contact: hello@nuit.works or @nuit.works on Instagram.
